## Workflow

A workflow has been written in Nextflow to manage the data analysis steps.
Nextflow is used to run the tasks on the HPC cluster <cluster>.
The workflow analyses can be run within `screen` or `tmux` sessions
as follows:

```bash
pixi run <numbered-analysis-task>
```

The workflow runs the following data processing and analyses steps for each sample.

- <STEP 1 (tool used)>
- <STEP 2 (tool used)>
- <STEP 3 (tool used)>

## Software

The following tools were used in the current analysis:

| Tool        | Version    | Description | Citation   |
| ----------- | ---------- | ------------------------------------ | ---------- |
| <tool> | <version> | <description> | [@citation-key] |

All the tools used in this project are available as Apptainer container
images (`*.{img,sif}`) in the folder
`<project_root>/scratch/apptainer-cache`. The container
image and version each Apptainer image was made from can be found in
the workflow's config files under `<project_root>/code/workflows/<name>/conf/`.

Custom container images are uploaded to `ghcr.io` (GitHub container registry) and associated
with the project repository. Images hosted on `ghcr.io` are initially private if the code
repository is private. These images should be copied to a public repository on publication.
Request access to the code repository from the NBIS expert to
have access to the Docker container images. All other Docker images
are hosted on public registries.
